contract: A variant belongs to its parent enum declaration; instantiated parent arguments belong to the ordinary checked application environment.
Qualified type paths select that declaration before resolving the member.
All declaration rows are retained in the existing GPU candidate index, allowing exact parent filtering and explicit ambiguous-name rejection.
Duplicate validation compares exact parent scopes. A module-level use of a name visible from different enum parents rejects.
Local/source-pack/imported forms preserve constructor and pattern ownership; no stdlib-specific implementation.
verification: Original qualified local/imported call, payload, and duplicate-parent reproductions execute.
Bare and called unit values; payloads; qualified match patterns; explicit parent type/constant headers.
Same-name parents with reversed declaration order; wrong-family members and ambiguous unqualified names reject.
Module import visibility and generic method controls; focused execution/diagnostic tests; existing performance tools.
